stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns Sign with AEW
stories.tldr: Motor City Machine Guns Chris Sabin and Alex Shelley made a surprise debut on AEW Collision in their hometown of Detroit on July 30, 2026, officially announcing they had signed with the company. The signing comes after their WWE release in April 2026 and the completion of their 90-day non-compete clause. AEW President Tony Khan confirmed the signing on social media, and the duo later assisted the Bang Bang Gang in a post-match angle against the Death Riders and The Dogs.

stories.title: AEW Continental Cup Tournament
stories.tldr: AEW announced a brand-new 16-man Continental Cup tournament on the July 30 episode of Collision, debuting next week and concluding at All In London on August 30. The tournament will feature random draws inspired by England's FA Cup, with the winner claiming both the Continental Cup trophy and the AEW Continental Championship. Commentator Nigel McGuinness announced his participation, joining confirmed competitors Jon Moxley, Orange Cassidy, Kyle O'Reilly, and Roderick Strong.

stories.title: Jim Ross AEW & Tony Khan
stories.tldr: Jim Ross praised AEW President Tony Khan as "a blessing in my life" while discussing his health challenges and upcoming brain surgery scheduled for August. The legendary broadcaster expressed gratitude for Khan's support during his health battles and hopes to return to work at AEW All In in London following the procedure. Ross's current AEW contract expires in August, continuing a pattern of short-term deal renewals.

stories.title: AEW MyAEW Streaming Expansion
stories.tldr: AEW has announced that six new independent wrestling promotions from around the world have joined the MyAEW streaming service, significantly expanding its content library. The additions include major European promotions RevPro and wXw, women's wrestling company Pro Wrestling Eve, and several U.S.-based indies. The expansion sets the stage for a packed August schedule culminating in AEW All In: London on August 30.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair & Danhausen AEW Connection
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair has praised Danhausen for helping her showcase a more fun and energetic side of her personality, expressing interest in teaming with the popular character in WWE. The 14-time World Champion is now pursuing her 15th title win in a Five-way ladder match for the Interim WWE Women's Championship, emphasizing how consistency and perseverance can lead to breaking records regardless of age or industry challenges.

stories.title: Tony Khan Detroit AEW Dynamite Announcement
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan announced to the live Detroit crowd after the July 29 Dynamite broadcast that he wants to bring a pay-per-view to Little Caesars Arena, asking fans to contact the venue about securing a weekend date. The announcement came after multiple PPV chants during the show, and Khan had previously appeared on stage with Insane Clown Posse before the taping. AEW is returning to the same venue for a special Thursday night episode of Collision on July 30.

stories.title: Will Ospreay AEW Grand Slam Mexico
stories.tldr: Ospreay's match against Mark Davis at AEW Grand Slam Mexico has been upgraded to a Mexico City Street Fight after a brutal post-match attack on Collision. Ospreay also discussed his value to Tony Khan, crediting his five-star matches with helping secure his AEW contract.

stories.title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico Matches & Card Updates
stories.tldr: AEW significantly upgraded the Grand Slam Mexico card on Collision with major additions including a Trios title defense, Hangman Page's return to in-ring competition, and the stipulation change for Ospreay vs. Davis to a Mexico City street fight. The show has grown into a stacked 2.5-hour event featuring multiple championship matches and high-profile international talent.

stories.title: Tony Khan Addresses AEW Roster Size & WWE Signings
stories.tldr: Khan elaborated on AEW's new PPV strategy, moving start times up by one hour to ensure East Coast broadcasts end before midnight while maintaining reasonable West Coast times. The earlier start time proved successful at the recent Redemption event in Montreal. Khan stressed the difficulty of accommodating all available free agents given the competitive landscape for TV and PPV spots on both Dynamite and Collision.

stories.title: WWE Baffled by Tony Khan AEW Booking
stories.tldr: WWE officials remain interested in signing Persephone if her AEW deal expires, viewing her star potential as being wasted in her current role. The comparison to Stephanie Vaquer—who WWE rapidly elevated after her AEW run—suggests Khan's reluctance to feature Persephone prominently may backfire when her contract becomes available.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Notes & Appearances
stories.tldr: ICP made their on-screen debut Thursday on Collision, participating in an Ice Bucket Challenge with Rhino to raise ALS awareness funds. The segment built momentum for the Rebel Heart tribute Dynamite on September 9, with Britt Baker recently visiting longtime AEW worker Rebel (Tanea Brooks), who was diagnosed with ALS earlier this year. One hundred percent of Rebel Heart merchandise proceeds will go to the I Am ALS Foundation.

stories.title: The New Day AEW All In London 2026
stories.tldr: Following their July 29 "Daybreak" video, Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods are now expected to debut at AEW All In London 2026, where they could align with Swerve Strickland, reunite with The Hurt Syndicate, enter a Tag Team Casino Gauntlet, confront returning FTR, or interfere in the AEW World Tag Team Championship match between Cage and Cope versus The Young Bucks.

stories.title: AEW Willow Nightingale vs Mercedes Moné
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale will defend her AEW Women's World Championship against Mercedes Mone at All In London 2026 after signing the contract on the July 29 episode of Dynamite. However, the match was originally planned with the roles reversed, with Mone supposed to be champion heading into the bout. Tony Khan reportedly restructured his plans to ensure he could still deliver this particular matchup.

stories.title: ICP ALS Challenge AEW Collision
stories.tldr: During AEW Collision on July 30, Insane Clown Posse and former WWE star Rhino participated in an ALS Ice Bucket Challenge to support Rebel's fight against the disease. The segment featured Violent J paying tribute to ECW legend Sabu and resulted in The Conglomeration members getting drenched by ice water in front of their Detroit hometown crowd.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Talent & Match Updates
stories.tldr: WWE SummerSlam 2026 is shaping up with multiple storyline developments as the two-night event approaches in Minneapolis. Key updates include Solo Sikoa receiving significant backstage praise for his babyface work with potential for an extended character run, Grayson Waller's controversial return to NXT sparking mockery from fellow roster members, and various wrestlers discussing their career aspirations and character developments heading into the premium live event.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown July 31 Go-Home Episode
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on July 31, 2026, will air live from the Resch Center in Green Bay, Wisconsin at 8 PM ET as the go-home show before SummerSlam. The card features a highly anticipated face-to-face confrontation between Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk and challenger Cody Rhodes, a WWE Tag Team Championship defense by Damian Priest and R-Truth against The War Raiders, and the final Interim Women's Championship Ladder Match Qualifier between Giulia and Lash Legend. NFL star Micah Parsons will attend the event.

stories.title: Vince Russo Triple H WWE Creative Criticism
stories.tldr: Vince Russo, the former WWE head writer, harshly criticized Triple H's creative direction during an appearance on Talk is Jericho, calling it "the worst creative in the history of WWE" and worse than previous eras. Russo suggested that Triple H's political maneuvering is preventing the company from hearing outside perspectives that could help improve the product, though he acknowledged Triple H would likely never consider his input.

stories.title: Logan Paul WWE vs AEW Crossover
stories.tldr: WWE's Logan Paul and AEW's Big BOOM AJ met at the National Sports Collectors Convention in Chicago where they participated in an impromptu "Boom-Off" competition. The two social media-turned-wrestlers engaged in a playful 30-second contest to see who could shout "boom" with more energy and conviction. Big BOOM AJ ultimately emerged victorious, and the lighthearted crossover moment between the rival wrestling promotions went viral on social media.

stories.title: WWE Trademarks & Filings
stories.tldr: WWE has filed multiple new trademark applications with the USPTO, including AWA for merchandise and toys, along with three video game-related titles: WWE Lock It In, WWE Championship Gold, and WWE Scratchcard. The filings also include wrestler ring names Cruz Montana and Alix Brooks, as well as WWE Radio. The AWA trademark is particularly notable as WWE previously held and abandoned a similar trademark from 2010 to 2014.

stories.title: WWE EVOLVE Talent Steps Away
stories.tldr: Cyrus Habibi-Likio, a WWE EVOLVE talent and former college football player, has announced his departure from WWE after less than a year with the promotion. His decision to step away was motivated by his wife's pregnancy with their third child, proximity to family in California, the ability to focus on his real estate business, and strengthening his faith and church community involvement. Despite leaving, Habibi-Likio expressed gratitude toward WWE and left open the possibility of returning to wrestling in the future.

stories.title: Mickie James ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: WWE legend Mickie James has launched an Ice Bucket Challenge fundraiser to support her friend Rebel, who is battling terminal ALS. Fans can donate $5 per raffle entry for the chance to dump ice on James live at WrestleCon Minneapolis on August 2, with 100 percent of proceeds benefiting I AM ALS, a patient-led organization dedicated to ALS research and support.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026 Preview & Coverage
stories.tldr: ESPN is introducing a new "Moment of the Night" championship belt at SummerSlam that will be awarded to the most impactful performance each night. CM Punk predicts his rivalry with Cody Rhodes will extend far beyond their SummerSlam title match, while creative remains divided on the Women's Ladder Match and Balor vs. Zayn.

stories.title: Royce Keys WWE Run
stories.tldr: Keys revealed that Triple H personally had his eye on him during WrestleMania week, viewing his SummerSlam spot as validation that WWE trusts him. He also opened up about his 14-year friendship with Jacob Fatu, acknowledging they have a deep history together despite now being on opposing sides at the pay-per-view.

stories.title: WWE Creative Pressure After Raw July 27
stories.tldr: The July 27 RAW episode's poor 2.73 Cagematch rating has triggered internal pressure at WWE, intensified by Netflix executives attending the show. Backstage scrutiny has focused on the opening segment's technical issues and Femi's botched finish, while creative staff reportedly questioned the decision to feature Ryan Garcia despite his recent controversies.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa WWE Babyface Run
stories.tldr: WWE's initial plan was to keep Solo Sikoa's babyface run temporary, but positive crowd reactions have sparked internal discussions about extending it indefinitely. Backstage sources reveal creative and fellow talent have long known about his charisma and humor, traits that were previously hidden during his silent Bloodline tenure.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown PPV Card Announcements
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling announced multiple matches for its Lockdown pay-per-view on August 23 in Chicago, with all bouts taking place inside steel cages. The card includes title defenses from The Hardys (Tag Team Champions), Cedric Alexander (X-Division Champion), and the Knockouts World Tag Team Champions, plus a grudge match between AJ Francis and Elijah.

stories.title: AAA Triplemania 34 Venue Change
stories.tldr: WWE announced that AAA TripleMania 34's Night One, originally scheduled for the Luxor in Las Vegas on September 11, has been moved to the larger MGM Grand Garden Arena due to unprecedented demand. The previously sold-out event will maintain its original date and start time, with existing ticket holders receiving information about transfers and new tickets going on sale August 4.

stories.title: TNA Amateur Wrestling Partnership
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has partnered with :30 Second Takedown, a new amateur wrestling tournament created by Rich Christensen (creator of the motorsports series PINKS), featuring 32 elite amateur wrestlers competing in 30-second matches. The tournament will air on TNA+ immediately after TNA Bound For Glory on October 11, 2026, and will be filmed in Iowa with matches determined by randomly drawn cards.

stories.title: TAKAYAMANIA EMPIRE V Matches
stories.tldr: TAKAYAMANIA EMPIRE V, the annual benefit show for paralyzed former wrestler Yoshihiro Takayama, continues to build its card with two newly announced matches. The September 7th event at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo will feature Hideki Suzuki vs. Danshoku Dieno and a tag team match with Chihiro Hashimoto and Ryo Mizunami facing Hiroyo Matsumoto and Miyu Yamashita. The show will also feature several wrestling legends as special guests.

stories.title: TNA Roster Teases & Departures
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling blurred the lines between storyline and reality on the July 30 episode of iMPACT when Daria Rae teased releasing Harley Hudson from the company due to her recent losing streak. The segment featured Santino Marella defending Hudson by highlighting her commitment to the promotion, while Rae insisted that performance matters most and threatened to take the issue to TNA's Board of Directors. Hudson's struggles have been compounded by recent losses, including her tag team partner Myla Grace receiving her release and Hudson's first-round elimination from the Knockouts Television Championship tournament at the hands of WWE NXT star Thea Hail.

stories.title: TNA Knockouts Title Matches
stories.tldr: Wendy Choo, formerly of WWE, will challenge Xia Brookside for the TNA Knockouts World Championship on the August 6th episode of Thursday Night iMPACT. The show will also feature Matt Hardy facing Ryan Nemeth, and the Knockouts Television Title Tournament match between Heather by Elegance and Mara Sadè, though Sadè's status remains uncertain following her contract expiration.

stories.title: Marigold Ring Announcer Health Update
stories.tldr: Marigold ring announcer Oki "Okky" Okita has been diagnosed with Stage 4 colon cancer that has spread to other areas of his body. The veteran announcer, whose 30-year career spans multiple Japanese wrestling promotions, discovered the illness after noticing physical abnormalities and is currently hospitalized preparing for chemotherapy. Marigold is hosting a benefit event on August 9 to support Okita during his treatment, with the wrestling community rallying behind the respected voice.

stories.title: Dark Side of the Ring Big Bossman Episode
stories.tldr: The Big Bossman episode of Dark Side of the Ring season 7 drew 135,000 viewers and a 0.04 rating in the 18-49 demographic, marking the lowest viewership of the season. The episode aired on Tuesday, July 28 on Vice TV, underperforming compared to previous season 7 episodes which ranged from 151,000 to 180,000 viewers.

stories.title: Dark Side of the Ring Viewership & Bonus Content
stories.tldr: A wrestling journalist reviewed the classic blue steel cage match between Hulk Hogan and The Big Boss Man from Saturday Night's Main Event XXI in May 1989, where Hogan successfully defended his WWF Championship despite interference from Big Boss Man's manager Slick and the surprise appearance of Zeus. The match featured the typical Hulk Hogan formula with the signature hulking up sequence and dramatic near-escapes, ultimately won when Hogan handcuffed Big Boss Man to the cage door and escaped over the top. This was the first of three unsuccessful WWF Championship matches for Big Boss Man, with his other title shots coming against The Rock and The Big Show.

stories.title: NJPW Drilla Moloney PRODUCE Wrestling Deal
stories.tldr: NJPW's Drilla Moloney has signed a multi-fight deal with PRODUCE Wrestling that will see him perform at least five shows through the end of 2026, with his debut scheduled for September 13th at White Eagle Hall in Jersey City. The current PROGRESS Wrestling Tag Team Champion and two-time IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Champion joins a promotion that features an impressive roster of international wrestling talent.

stories.title: Title Changes Wrestling History July 30
stories.tldr: July 30th has seen 214 major professional wrestling title changes throughout history, making it a moderately significant date in the sport. Notable champions crowned on this date include Stan Hansen winning the AJPW/PWF Heavyweight Title in 1985, Booker T capturing the WCW World Heavyweight Title in 2001, Mick Foley winning the TNA Legends Title in 2009, and Takashi Sugiura claiming the GHC Heavyweight Title in 2016.

stories.title: Caleb Konley Interview
stories.tldr: Caleb Konley, a 21-year veteran wrestler and lifelong Insane Clown Posse fan, discussed his journey as JCW Lunacy Heavyweight Champion in an interview with Arizona James Walsh. Konley revealed how his passion for Juggalo culture since age 14 has finally merged with his wrestling career, and he praised ICP's collaborative creative approach and commitment to delivering Attitude Era-style "crash TV" wrestling.

stories.title: International Fight Week Arena Mexico
stories.tldr: International Fight Week is taking place at Arena Mexico from August 4-7, 2026, featuring major title matches across AEW, ROH, and NJPW. The week includes a CMLL show on Tuesday with multiple championship bouts, AEW Grand Slam on Wednesday, and the CMLL International Grand Prix on Friday, bringing together talent from wrestling promotions worldwide.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth TNA Roster Updates
stories.tldr: Nic Nemeth argues that media attention on TNA Wrestling's recent departures has overshadowed the company's simultaneous roster additions and internal development efforts. Nemeth highlighted several emerging talents and returning acts that he believes demonstrate TNA's strength, suggesting the company may actually have gained more wrestlers than it lost and comparing how WWE roster changes receive less scrutiny than TNA's smaller-scale exits.

stories.title: Summer Slam 2024:Almost Lost In Cleveland
stories.tldr: A wrestling news editor recounts his experience traveling to SummerSlam 2024 in Cleveland, drawing parallels to the infamous "Lost in Cleveland" storyline from WCW's past. After previously attending SummerSlam 2023 in Detroit with wrestling content producer Mike Sorg, the editor agreed to make the shorter trip to Cleveland with Pat MacLaughlin, alongside other wrestling events happening that weekend including Game Changer Wrestling and WrestleCon.

stories.title: GUNTHER Reveals Why He Never Formed Another Faction After Imperium
stories.tldr: GUNTHER has revealed he has no plans to form another faction following Imperium's dissolution, explaining that successful stables must develop naturally rather than being forced together for creative purposes. The Ring General prefers operating as a solo competitor, a role he's been comfortable with throughout most of his career, and believes adding allies wouldn't benefit his current position in WWE.

stories.title: Brie Bella Explains How Bryan Danielson Made Her WWE Return Possible
stories.tldr: Brie Bella credits her husband Bryan Danielson's retirement from full-time wrestling with making her WWE return possible, as his transition to being the primary parent at home allowed her to resume her in-ring career. Danielson has thrived in his new domestic role, even improving their children's academic performance in reading and math. Brie will compete in a six-woman tag team match at SummerSlam alongside Paige and her sister Nikki Bella.

stories.title: TNA Impact Championship Changes & Tournament Updates
stories.tldr: Internal Order 4 drama erupted during Hotch's championship victory as multiple faction members interfered in different ways, with Tasha Steelz preventing Ali from cheating and Mila Moore subsequently attacking her. Additionally, TNA is considering terminating Harley Hudson's contract due to her recent loss streak, while actress Aimee Garcia made a surprise appearance ringside.

stories.title: TNA Honors Rebel/Tanea Brooks for ALS
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling paid on-air tribute to Rebel during the July 30 episode of iMPACT, with commentators Tom Hannifan and Matthew Rehwoldt delivering a message of support on behalf of the company. The tribute recognized Brooks' two separate runs with TNA between 2013-2018 and acknowledged her as a valued member of the TNA family. The gesture adds to wrestling's broader show of solidarity as Brooks continues her ALS battle.

stories.title: AJ Styles Recalls Backstage Atmosphere Before & After Final WWE Match
stories.tldr: AJ Styles opened up about the emotional moments immediately following his retirement match against GUNTHER at the 2026 Royal Rumble, describing how the entire roster greeted him backstage and how he needed a private moment to process the finality of his in-ring career. The veteran wrestler found solace in a quiet locker room before returning to accept support from colleagues like Shane Helms.

stories.title: General Wrestling Commentary and Opinions
stories.tldr: Al Snow criticized wrestlers who selectively praise Dave Meltzer and fans when they agree with them while rejecting criticism, arguing this reflects insecurity and hypocrisy in the wrestling industry. Snow also contended that wrestling companies don't owe fans explanations for creative decisions, saying the industry created its own problem by revealing too much backstage information while simultaneously resenting the scrutiny that follows.

stories.title: AEW vs. CMLL August 4 Event
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a 10-match card for its AEW vs. CMLL co-promotional event taking place on August 4, 2026, from Arena Mexico in Mexico City. The card features a mix of AEW and CMLL talent competing across multiple match types, including two championship bouts with ROH Champion Bandido facing Barbaro Cavernario and AEW TNT Champion Kevin Knight defending against Titan. The event kicks off CMLL's Semana Internacional, with AEW's Grand Slam: Mexico Dynamite episode scheduled for the following night.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite 7/29/2026 Review
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay traded violent slaps in a heated face-to-face segment that escalated their already fractured relationship ahead of All In, while Ospreay formally quit the Death Riders by returning his patch to Jon Moxley. The Demand captured the AEW World Trios Championship from The Conglomeration with help from The Lethal Twist, setting up a potential multi-team feud, and Hangman Page returned to the show for the first time in 140 days to make the save post-match.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 Wembley
stories.tldr: Christian Cage took a subtle shot at The Young Bucks during a sit-down interview, referencing their wives attending All In and suggesting they're trying to convince themselves they're ready rather than truly believing it. AEW also announced the Men's Casino Gauntlet Match will return for the third consecutive year at All In, with the winner earning a future AEW World Championship shot.

stories.title: Tony Khan Insane Clown Posse Invitation
stories.tldr: Tony Khan personally invited Insane Clown Posse to tonight's AEW Dynamite in Detroit, with Violent J confirmed to be backstage at the Masonic Temple. Khan, who is a fan of ICP's Juggalo Championship Wrestling promotion, wanted to meet with J before the show. It remains unclear if Shaggy 2 Dope is also in attendance.

stories.title: AEW Collision 7/30/2026
stories.tldr: The Bang Bang Gang vs. Death Riders match has been clarified as an eight-man tag, with Jon Moxley and Claudio Castagnoli confirmed as part of the Death Riders team. Will Ospreay's singles match against Daniel Garcia stems from his recent departure from the Death Riders faction after aiding AEW World Champion Kenny Omega at Redemption.

stories.title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico August 5 Event
stories.tldr: AEW has added two matches to Grand Slam Mexico on August 5. Will Ospreay will face Mark Davis in a no-interference singles match, while AEW Women's World Champion Willow Nightingale and The Brawling Birds will face Mercedes Moné and Divine Dominion in six-woman tag team action. These bouts follow storyline developments from the July 29 episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo AEW National Championship
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo successfully defended his AEW National Championship against Jack Perry and Nick Wayne in a three-way match on Dynamite. AEW has announced a qualification match at Grand Slam Mexico next week, where Andrade can earn the coveted number one entry position in the Casino Gauntlet match at All In London, which guarantees a future world title shot.

stories.title: AEW TBS Championship
stories.tldr: Maya World successfully defended her AEW TBS Championship against Persephone at Dynamite with assistance from Kris Statlander, who prevented Hikaru Shida from interfering. Looking ahead, World has expressed interest in facing Athena at AEW All In London 2026, citing unfinished business between them despite Athena's historical dominance in their previous matchups.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns AEW Speculation
stories.tldr: Tony Khan emphasized that AEW's roster is so deep he must be "very considerate" about signing new talent, suggesting the Motor City Machine Guns may not automatically get spots despite the hometown speculation. Khan also revealed his new philosophy on PPV timing, successfully ending Redemption before midnight by starting an hour earlier at 7 p.m. ET instead of the typical 8 p.m. start.

stories.title: Will Ospreay and Kenny Omega Conflict at AEW
stories.tldr: The Ospreay vs. Omega AEW World Championship match is officially scheduled for August 30 at All In London 2026 at Wembley Stadium. The report identifies eight potential challengers should Ospreay win the title, including Andrade El Idolo, Kyle Fletcher, Swerve Strickland, Kazuchika Okada, and Darby Allin, each with their own storyline connection to the champion.

stories.title: Triple H WWE Creative Commentary
stories.tldr: Triple H has taken significant criticism from industry figures like Vince Russo over his WWE creative direction since taking control in 2024, though Triple H himself remains defensive about fan criticism of creative decisions. In recent podcast appearances, Triple H emphasized that wrestling is meant to be entertainment, defended the WWE: Unreal Netflix series against legends' complaints, and reflected on his philosophies regarding talent development, house shows, and the business itself.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Heart Surgery
stories.tldr: WWE's Chelsea Green underwent emergency heart surgery in May 2026 to treat supraventricular tachycardia (SVT), a condition that caused her heart rate to spike to 228 beats per minute during a signing. The procedure was traumatic because doctors intentionally woke her mid-surgery to trigger another episode and confirm the treatment worked, leaving her with PTSD and nightmares. Despite the frightening experience requiring therapy, Green has returned to in-ring competition and says only death would stop her from wrestling.

stories.title: WWE Releases and Departures
stories.tldr: Kai Kavari, a former WWE NXT and Evolve wrestler who signed a three-year contract in November 2025, has announced his departure from the company. Citing family obligations, financial constraints, and religious reasons, Kavari explained he could earn more money through real estate in California than his current WWE salary would allow. Additionally, Mara Sade, formerly known as Jakara Jackson during her WWE tenure, has become a free agent after her TNA Wrestling contract expired and is now negotiating with multiple companies.

stories.title: Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods (The New Day) Free Agency
stories.tldr: Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods released an emotional animated video titled "Daybreak" on July 29, 2026, as their 90-day WWE noncompete clauses are set to expire in the coming week. The video uses circus unicorn symbolism to depict their escape from WWE, including a poignant reference to Big E who remains with WWE as a commentator with a broken neck. While the video doesn't confirm their destination, industry speculation universally points to AEW, with many expecting them to debut at All In at Wembley Stadium on August 30.

stories.title: Chad Gable WWE Career Development
stories.tldr: Chad Gable credits The Undertaker with unlocking a major breakthrough in his wrestling performance, particularly during his El Grande Americano storyline, after initially struggling to understand the WWE Hall of Famer's coaching. Gable also reflected on the difficult "Shorty G" era in 2019, revealing that Luke Harper sent him an encouraging text after his first promo in that character, which helped him through one of his lowest points in WWE.

stories.title: The Undertaker WWE Legacy and Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: The Undertaker recently revealed that in his 30-year partnership with Vince McMahon, there was only one time McMahon admitted he was wrong about a creative decision: the Punjabi Prison match at The Great American Bash 2006. Additionally, Undertaker expressed frustration that McMahon never adequately explained why he refused to book the long-anticipated dream match between Undertaker and Sting at WrestleMania 31, which both wrestlers and fans considered a "no-brainer" that became wrestling's biggest missed opportunity.

stories.title: GUNTHER (formerly WALTER) WWE
stories.tldr: WWE legend Vince McMahon changed WALTER's ring name to GUNTHER because he feared fans would nickname the wrestler "Wally," which he believed was unsuitable for a main event foreign menace heel character. Despite initial fan skepticism about the name change, GUNTHER has become one of WWE's top stars and is scheduled to face Nick Aldis at SummerSlam 2026. The decision to rebrand the wrestler when he moved from NXT UK to the main NXT roster has remained a topic of discussion among fans.

stories.title: CM Punk and Rey Mysterio WWE Retirement Plans
stories.tldr: CM Punk and Rey Mysterio, both in the final stages of their legendary wrestling careers, have expressed mutual interest in facing each other one last time before retirement. The two icons last competed against each other in 2012 but have teamed together more recently, including a December match on WWE Raw. Both stars confirmed their enthusiasm for the matchup at San Diego Comic-Con, with Mysterio joking he could wrestle immediately and Punk declaring his eagerness to face the WWE Hall of Famer.

stories.title: Sol Ruca WWE Women's IC Title
stories.tldr: Sol Ruca's WWE Women's Intercontinental Championship reign ended after two months when she lost the title to Raquel Rodriguez on Raw. Charlotte Flair offered advice to the young wrestler, encouraging her to learn from the loss and use it as motivation to improve her craft, emphasizing that early setbacks don't define a career.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton WWE Character Development
stories.tldr: Tiffany Stratton has expressed interest in reviving her "Daddy's Little Rich Girl" character from her NXT days and believes Paul Heyman would be the perfect fit to fill the "Daddy" role. The WWE Women's United States Champion praised Heyman's track record of elevating talent and suggested the character could be reimagined in a different way than it originally appeared. Stratton is currently preparing for an interim women's title ladder match at WWE SummerSlam taking place August 1-2 in Minneapolis.

stories.title: AJ Styles WWE NXT Production
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently traveled to the WWE Performance Center where he produced a match between Tony D and Naraku on WWE NXT. Styles praised both competitors' performances and expressed his enjoyment of his new role as a producer and coach, saying he loves inspiring younger talent and being involved in helping create quality matches.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns will return to Money in the Bank for the first time since 2023 on October 10 in New Orleans, with WWE confirming an extensive post-SummerSlam schedule featuring multiple Raw appearances through the fall. Triple H revealed Brock Lesnar's future remains uncertain after his Hell in a Cell match, saying the decision to retire—or continue—will be entirely up to Lesnar in real time. Nick Aldis makes his WWE in-ring debut against Gunther at SummerSlam, while ESPN's decision to not simulcast the opening hour signals concerns about subscription numbers for its WWE streaming coverage.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio WWE and AAA Career
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio has set his sights on retiring his father Rey Mysterio in a high-profile match, insisting it's his "birthright" to end the Hall of Famer's career. He's also confirmed his sister Aalyah is joining WWE's Performance Center full-time, while sharing personal insights about his marriage, his early career path, and his current role in both WWE and AAA.

stories.title: WWE NXT Grayson Waller
stories.tldr: John Cena publicly praised Grayson Waller's promo, tweeting that Waller has "found his WHY" and expressing eagerness to see what comes next. The promo was compared to a worked-shoot "pipe bomb" style segment and generated significant industry buzz. Multiple main roster talents have been discussed as potential NXT calldowns in the wake of Waller's momentum.

stories.title: Liv Morgan WWE Women's World Championship
stories.tldr: Liv Morgan will finally defend her WWE Women's World Championship against Iyo Sky at SummerSlam on August 1, ending her 100-day reign without a title defense. Sky earned the opportunity by winning the Queen of the Ring Tournament finals against Morgan at Night of Champions. The match will take place at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis as part of night one of the two-night event.

stories.title: Ludwig Kaiser Battery Case Hearing
stories.tldr: Ludwig Kaiser's hearing on his motion to dismiss the battery charge has been scheduled for October 19. Before then, prosecutors and the defense will meet for a second pre-trial conference on August 27, where a plea agreement could potentially be reached. Kaiser previously waived his right to a speedy trial, pushing back what would have been an August trial date.

stories.title: WWE Tryouts SummerSlam Week
stories.tldr: WWE's SummerSlam week tryouts in Minnesota are underway with a detailed schedule spanning Tuesday through Friday. The process includes physicals, multiple rounds of in-ring training, promo sessions, and matches, with former AEW star Fuego Del Sol (KJ Orso) among the participants who have not publicly announced their involvement.

stories.title: Roman Reigns Post-SummerSlam Schedule
stories.tldr: WWE has announced Roman Reigns' schedule through October, confirming his appearance at Money in the Bank on October 10 in New Orleans. The event was moved from its original August 29 date and will serve as compensation for relocating WrestleMania 42 away from New Orleans to Las Vegas. Both the men's and women's Money in the Bank ladder matches are confirmed for the card.

stories.title: Aalyah Mysterio WWE Performance Center
stories.tldr: Aalyah Mysterio is set to officially begin training at the WWE Performance Center shortly. Recent viral Instagram posts from her friends celebrated the milestone with a cake decorated with wrestling imagery and messages welcoming her to WWE, though the company and Mysterio family have not yet made an official announcement.

stories.title: Kay Lee Ray (Alba Fyre) Post-WWE
stories.tldr: Kay Lee Ray, recently departed from WWE after eight years with the company, has spoken positively about her post-WWE indie run and called Nia Jax a genuine locker room leader who supports other women backstage despite receiving negative online reputation. Ray highlighted winning the Women's Tag Team Championship with Isla Dawn at Clash at the Castle in Glasgow as her favorite WWE memory, and expressed that she is enjoying being herself again after her lengthy WWE tenure.

stories.title: CMLL 93 Anniversary
stories.tldr: CMLL is building toward its 93rd Anniversary event on September 18 with a featured Lucha De Apuestas mask match between the winners of Templario & Último Guerrero versus Dragón Rojo Jr & Bárbaro Cavernario. Before that on July 31, CMLL is holding a stacked Friday show featuring championship matches for Tessa Blanchard, Roderick Strong, and Thunder Rosa, plus the Leyenda de Plata tournament final between Mascara Dorada and Komander.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Announced For MLP Northern Rising
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland has been announced for Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling's Northern Rising event on October 3 at TMU's Mattany Athletic Centre in Toronto. The announcement came at the end of MLP Mayhem on July 30, marking Copeland's appearance at the historic venue he expressed interest in performing at back in 2023. Currently one-half of the AEW Tag Team Champions with Christian Cage, Copeland will be defending those titles at AEW All In against The Young Bucks.

stories.title: WWE Star Fires Back At Fan Criticism, ‘Everybody’s Always Got Something To Say’
stories.tldr: Royce Keys, the former AEW star who debuted in WWE at the 2026 Royal Rumble, has responded to ongoing fan criticism about his name change and initial absence from televised programming. Keys acknowledged that he receives constant pushback but has learned not to let it affect him, explaining that he now focuses on the responsibility he feels to his family, community, and the people who support him rather than worrying about pleasing everyone.

stories.title: Former WWE personality says Danhausen/Joe Hendry concert was “the worst segment” he has ever seen
stories.tldr: During WWE RAW on July 27, 2026, a concert segment featuring Danhausen and Joe Hendry was interrupted by boxer Ryan Garcia and Judgment Day. Former WWE personality Jonathan Coachman criticized it as "the worst segment" he's ever witnessed, calling out the booking decisions and expressing concern for the performers involved, particularly Dirty Dom's repositioning in the card.

stories.title: Kurt Angle Says Being Moved To WWE ECW Felt Like A 'Demotion' At The Time
stories.tldr: Kurt Angle revealed that his 2006 move to WWE's ECW brand felt like a career demotion at the time, as he was transitioning from main event status to a smaller brand with lower pay and fewer resources. McMahon reportedly wanted to position Angle as the face of ECW's hardcore wrestling style, possibly modeling him after the original ECW's Taz, though Angle initially resisted the move. However, in previous interviews, Angle had described his ECW run differently, claiming he was more concerned about the brand lacking WWE's full support rather than viewing it as a demotion.

stories.title: Daily Update: Triple H, Ari Emanuel, WWE most shocking SummerSlam moments countdown
stories.tldr: Triple H appeared on ESPN to promote SummerSlam 2026, discussing Brock Lesnar's Hell in a Cell match against Oba Femi and whether it could be Lesnar's final bout. The Wrestling Observer Newsletter covers extensive wrestling news including AEW and WWE event previews, international wrestling developments, and business analysis across multiple promotions. Current stories include Tony Khan's approach to AEW signings, Dominik Mysterio's popularity in Mexico, and Roman Reigns' confirmed appearance for an October WWE Premium Live Event.

stories.title: Big Vinny V’s Mr. SummerSlam Countdown: Bret Hart hits at No. 3
stories.tldr: Bret Hart ranks third in a countdown of wrestlers with the most best matches at WWE's SummerSlam event, having eight such matches across 11 total SummerSlam appearances. Despite ranking behind two other wrestlers, Hart actually received more votes from Cagematch users as match of the night than either wrestler ahead of him, and only failed to deliver the show's best match twice in his 10 SummerSlam appearances.

stories.title: Paul Wight Shows Off Extreme Weight Loss: “Lowest Weight I’ve Been Since Before WCW”; Wrestling World Reacts
stories.tldr: Paul Wight, the legendary wrestler formerly known as The Big Show, has achieved his lowest weight since before joining WCW in the late 1990s at 360 pounds. The AEW star has been documenting his weight-loss transformation on social media over several months and expressed satisfaction with his progress and consistency. His update garnered supportive responses from notable wrestlers including Brian Cage, Kip Sabian, and Baron Corbin.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2001: Retro 3 Things We Hated & 3 Things We Loved
stories.tldr: WWE SummerSlam 2001 took place during the famous Invasion storyline when WWE faced off against WCW and ECW talent. The event featured a title vs. title match between X-Pac and Tajiri for the Cruiserweight and Light Heavyweight Championships, which would ultimately be the final PPV defense of the Light Heavyweight Championship before its retirement in 2002.

stories.title: DragonKingKarl: Trouble follows William Muldoon | Pioneer era wrestling
stories.tldr: In a new DragonKingKarl podcast episode examining William Muldoon's life through a recent biography, the discussion covers Muldoon's time in San Francisco where he continued both his theatrical work in "As You Like It" alongside Madame Modjeska and Maurice Barrymore while also wrestling on the West Coast. Despite his professional pursuits, Muldoon's schemes and poor decisions resulted in damaged friendships, the dissolution of his marriage, criminal arrest, and his involvement in a death on a boat.

stories.title: Bully Ray Talks Chances Of The Rock Challenging Roman Reigns At WWE WrestleMania 43
stories.tldr: Bully Ray believes WWE could set up a match between The Rock and Roman Reigns for WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia, potentially announced after Reigns defeats Seth Rollins at SummerSlam. Ray notes that Saudi Arabia has a history of paying top dollar for marquee matches featuring legends, making a Rock vs. Reigns clash a realistic possibility to generate interest for next year's WrestleMania.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez’s WWE NXT July 28, 2026 report
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez provided his detailed coverage of WWE NXT's July 28, 2026 episode for subscribers. The report offers professional wrestling analysis and commentary on the night's matches and programming. This was the standard Tuesday night NXT broadcast covered through his wrestling news service.

stories.title: Al Snow Claims Paul Heyman Used Multiple Email Accounts To Praise Himself To Wrestling Newsletters
stories.tldr: Al Snow has alleged that Paul Heyman used multiple email accounts to send praise about himself to wrestling newsletters, claiming this was a form of self-promotion and propaganda. Snow made these comments during an appearance on The Brand podcast while comparing Heyman unfavorably to Vince Russo, suggesting Russo did not engage in the same type of self-promotional behavior that he attributes to Heyman.

stories.title: PFL New York Predictions (07-31-2026)
stories.tldr: PFL New York takes place Friday at UBS Arena in Belmont Park with a lightweight title main event between champion Usman Nurmagomedov and undefeated challenger Archie Colgan. The editor predicts Nurmagomedov will retain via unanimous decision due to his superior chain wrestling and top control, with the champion's jab providing better long-range striking than Colgan's attack. The card features eight bouts with predictions across all matchups.

stories.title: Batista Explains Why He Will Never Wrestle Again
stories.tldr: WWE legend Batista explained in a recent interview that he will never wrestle again despite years of speculation about a comeback. He emphasized that he left wrestling at the perfect time with a storybook ending and refuses to tarnish his legacy, stating he would rather go broke than return to the ring. Batista discussed how he initially entered wrestling out of financial desperation but eventually became obsessed with it and left on his own terms at the height of his career.

stories.title: Danhausen Reveals How Long His Curses Last
stories.tldr: WWE star Danhausen recently discussed his cursing abilities in an interview with magician Anna, revealing that the duration of his curses varies depending on factors like his mood and the strength of the curse itself. He also credited Papa Shango as inspiration for learning how to curse people, though he describes himself as largely self-taught through watching videos online.

stories.title: Matt Cardona reveals why he wasn’t bothered by his Intercontinental title loss
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently explained that he wasn't bothered by losing his WWE Intercontinental Championship the night after winning it at WrestleMania 32, as he believes the short memorable reign perfectly captured the story of his career. The 41-year-old added that he's open to turning heel in WWE to showcase the ruthless "Ultimate Opportunist" character he developed during his time on the independent wrestling scene.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling Roster Changes
stories.tldr: Mara Sade's contract with TNA has expired and she's now fielding offers from multiple promotions while TNA remains in active negotiations to re-sign her. Meanwhile, TNA is promoting its Philadelphia shows with an invitation to LeBron James to be the official title holder for Nic Nemeth's world championship defense against Jeff Hardy, and former TNA World Champion Cruz Montana has explained his departure to WWE NXT was driven by a desire to stop feeling comfortable and continue his career growth.

stories.title: Adam Page Returns on AEW Dynamite and Offers to Help Will Ospreay
stories.tldr: Adam Page made his return to AEW television after a three-week absence, appearing during the opening segment of the July 29 Dynamite episode. He offered his support to Will Ospreay in his conflict with Jon Moxley, though Ospreay declined the help. Page's return marks the beginning of creative plans AEW had prepared for him heading into All In.

stories.title: WWE RAW Crashes to One of Its Lowest Cagematch Scores Ever After Ryan Garcia Debut
stories.tldr: The backlash to Ryan Garcia's WWE RAW appearance has intensified beyond social media, with fans now pointing to the celebrity cameo as a key factor in the episode receiving a 2.85 Cagematch score—one of the lowest in the show's history on the platform. While Garcia's concert segment with Joe Hendry and Danhausen has become the focal point of criticism, reviewers are increasingly arguing the entire show lacked direction, suggesting Garcia may have simply been the breaking point for an already struggling episode rather than the sole culprit.

stories.title: Cruz Montana says he understands Grayson Waller’s anger on NXT: ‘I had opportunities taken from me’
stories.tldr: Cruz Montana responded to Grayson Waller's recent NXT comments by sympathizing with the younger star's frustrations while defending the legacy of his TNA World Championship reign. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Montana acknowledged being in similar situations early in his career but emphasized that Waller doesn't understand his journey or the significance of what he accomplished in TNA.

stories.title: SiriusXM launches new $5 sports package that includes WWE Radio
stories.tldr: SiriusXM is launching a new Sports Pass subscription tier for $5/month on September 1 that bundles all of its sports channels together, including WWE Radio. The package also incorporates regional terrestrial sports radio stations and content from major sports media outlets like ESPN and Fox Sports. WWE Radio, which debuted this week as a rebrand of Pro Wrestling Nation 24/7, will now be accessible to a broader subscriber base through this tiered pricing model.

stories.title: Rhino Reveals What He Wants To Do On Tonight’s AEW Dynamite, Explains Why He Missed 2025 AEW Show
stories.tldr: Rhino revealed his dream opponents for tonight's AEW Dynamite in Detroit, naming Will Ospreay and Jon Moxley as top choices. He also expressed hope to share the ring with Adam Copeland and Christian Cage, noting it would be their first time together in a major promotion in roughly two decades. Additionally, Rhino explained that bad weather canceling his flights prevented him from appearing at AEW's 2300 Arena residency event in 2025.

stories.title: Triple H Made Live Creative Changes During WWE RAW Segment
stories.tldr: Triple H remained actively involved behind the scenes during the Lesnar vs. Femi weigh-in segment on RAW, making real-time creative decisions even without appearing prominently on screen. The report confirms he was "very much" in charge of directing the segment as it unfolded live.

stories.title: Summer Rae Discusses The Possibility Of Returning To WWE
stories.tldr: Summer Rae expressed openness to eventually returning to WWE while emphasizing her satisfaction with her current role in bare knuckle boxing broadcasting. She highlighted the physical toll of WWE's demanding 300-day road schedule and expressed appreciation for her newfound ability to have a social life. The former Superstar indicated she's enjoying her current position with BKB, which she says is "skyrocketing."

stories.title: AEW Detroit Dynamite Card Updates
stories.tldr: Former ECW World Champion Rhino is returning to AEW this week for the promotion's two-night stand in Detroit at the Masonic Temple Theater on July 29-30. While his exact role remains unannounced, Rhino has been actively promoting the events through local media and confirmed on the ROAR Around The Ring podcast that he plans to "show up there and try to gore someone." This marks his second appearance for AEW, following a loss to Nick Wayne during the company's previous Detroit visit in May 2025.

stories.title: Nick Jackson Health Update After AEW Redemption
stories.tldr: Nick Jackson suffered a head collision with Will Ospreay during The Young Bucks' match against Jon Moxley and Will Ospreay at AEW Redemption, causing immediate concern. However, Jackson passed multiple concussion tests and confirmed he did not suffer a concussion, though he did have his "bell rung" and experienced dizziness. The incident was complicated by a pre-existing whiplash injury from AEW Forbidden Door that has caused ongoing fogginess, and doctors attributed his slower recovery to insufficient carbohydrate and fluid intake.

stories.title: Kenny Omega AEW Retirement Opponent
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega, the current AEW World Champion, is planning to retire from in-ring competition in the near future after an illustrious career. The article examines ten potential opponents who could face Omega in his retirement match, ranging from Will Ospreay and MJF to established rivals like Jon Moxley and Chris Jericho. Each candidate represents different chapters of Omega's AEW tenure, offering unique narrative payoffs for his final bout.

stories.title: Daniel Garcia Phone-Smacking Incident at AEW Redemption
stories.tldr: Daniel Garcia allegedly faced a $10,000 fine from AEW following an incident at AEW Redemption where he appeared to knock phones out of fans' hands during a crowd exit. A fan who was involved contacted news outlets claiming the company reached out with compensation and information about the punishment. The incident involved at least three separate phone contact incidents, with one phone nearly falling off a balcony before Jon Moxley intervened.

stories.title: AEW Collision Viewership
stories.tldr: AEW Collision drew 427,000 viewers with a 0.07 demo rating on July 25, 2026, marking a week-over-week increase of 28,000 viewers and a 0.01 demo point gain. The episode showed strong year-over-year growth with a 30.6% viewership increase compared to the same week in 2025, though the demographic rating declined slightly by 12.5%. These figures represent linear TNT viewership only and do not include streaming or digital data.

stories.title: MJF AEW Plans After Losing World Championship
stories.tldr: Following his loss of the AEW World Championship to Kenny Omega at Dynamite Beach Break, MJF has been absent from television heading into AEW All In London 2026 at Wembley Stadium on August 30. With limited time to build storylines before the event, several potential matchups could be in store for The Devil, ranging from rematches with former rivals to completely fresh encounters with wrestlers he has never faced one-on-one in AEW.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland AEW Commentary
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland revealed that he immediately recognized Thekla's star potential when she debuted in AEW, predicting she would become a major player in the women's division. Thekla recently lost her AEW Women's World Championship to Willow Nightingale at AEW Redemption after a 165-day reign, but Strickland credits her success to her authentic personality rather than manufactured appeal.

stories.title: Chris Jericho AEW Status and Career
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho has definitively ended speculation about a WWE return, explaining that he weighed his options when his AEW contract expired last year but ultimately re-signed with AEW because of his personal investment in the company he helped create. At 55, Jericho is refusing to set a retirement timeline, comparing himself to The Rolling Stones and insisting he'll continue wrestling as long as he remains creatively fulfilled and can deliver at a high level.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Title Matches and Lineup Additions
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite on July 29 from Detroit adds two more title matches to its already stacked card. Newly crowned TBS Champion Maya World will defend against CMLL World Women's Champion Persephone, while new National Champion Andrade El Idolo faces a three-way defense against Jack Perry and Nick Wayne. AEW World Champion Kenny Omega will also appear on the show.

stories.title: Young Bucks AEW Redemption Match Planning
stories.tldr: The Young Bucks revealed they were heavily involved in designing their Redemption match against Moxley and Ospreay, feeling personal ownership over its success. They're now focused on their dream All In title shot against Copeland and Cage, which will complete their goal of facing all three legendary TLC-era tag teams. A sit-down interview between both teams airs Wednesday on Dynamite.

stories.title: AEW Podcast Network Update
stories.tldr: Tony Khan reiterated his commitment to the AEW Podcast Network during a media scrum, emphasizing that the project has been in development for quite a while and will be "excellent." The network appears positioned as a successor to AEW Unrestricted, which ended in 2023 after 316 episodes.

stories.title: WWE NXT July 28 Episode News
stories.tldr: The July 28, 2026 episode of WWE NXT featured Grayson Waller's shocking return from the main roster, where he cut a lengthy pipe bomb promo calling out Austin Theory, Cruz Montana, and the entire NXT men's roster while declaring his intention to win the NXT Championship. The show also set up multiple championship matches for August 4, including Kendal Grey defending the NXT Women's Championship against Lola Vice in an NXT Underground match, while the women's division continued to receive praise despite criticism of the largely meaningless Speed Championships.

stories.title: Bayley WWE Contract and Career Status
stories.tldr: Bayley has released a behind-the-scenes vlog reflecting on her career amid ongoing uncertainty about her WWE contract, which is set to expire before the end of 2026. In the video from her July 18 match against Lyra Valkyria at Madison Square Garden, Bayley stated that she now understands her place and worth in the wrestling business. Her comments come as speculation about her future intensifies, with reports suggesting interest from AEW and the possibility that she could pursue a change of scenery after accomplishing major goals in WWE.

stories.title: Aalyah Mysterio Joining WWE Performance Center
stories.tldr: Aalyah Mysterio, daughter of WWE Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio, is reportedly joining the WWE Performance Center following months of training. The 24-year-old recently graduated from UC San Diego with a degree in Human Biology and has completed trial training sessions that convinced her to pursue wrestling full-time. Social media posts from friends celebrating her move to Florida have fueled speculation, though WWE has not yet made an official announcement.

stories.title: KJ Orso/Fuego Del Sol WWE Tryout
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler KJ Orso, formerly known as masked luchador Fuego Del Sol during his time with AEW, is participating in WWE tryouts this week in Minnesota surrounding SummerSlam 2026. Orso unmasked in April 2025 after losing a career vs. mask match and has since been a regular on the independent circuit, particularly with GCW. While he didn't publicly announce the tryout, he acknowledged it through social media posts and has indicated he won't celebrate until he achieves his ultimate goal.

stories.title: WWE NXT on CW and ESPN
stories.tldr: The CW Network and ESPN have launched a streaming agreement bringing over 800 hours of CW Sports content to the ESPN App starting August 4, 2026, for ESPN Unlimited subscribers. WWE NXT will be featured prominently, including regular Tuesday episodes and Premium Live Events like NXT Heatwave on August 30. The partnership also includes NASCAR, college football from the ACC, Pac-12, and Mountain West conferences, expanding viewing options beyond traditional broadcast and Netflix.

stories.title: Rusev WWE Status
stories.tldr: Rusev quickly exited to the backstage area after losing to Je'Von Evans on WWE Raw on July 27, sparking debate among fans about whether the no-sell was intentional character work or a sign of genuine frustration. However, reports indicate Rusev may have suffered a hand injury during the match when he took Evans' Red Dot kick, with witnesses hearing him say "my hand went numb," which would explain his swift exit to get medical attention rather than any backstage issues.

stories.title: Logan Paul WWE Championship Goals
stories.tldr: Logan Paul continues to express unwavering confidence that winning the WWE World Championship is inevitable, despite falling short in multiple world title matches against top competitors. Speaking on his podcast, Paul emphasized that capturing the championship would represent a major turning point in his career and allow him to operate without restraint. While he has yet to capture the gold, WWE has consistently placed him in high-profile championship matches, keeping him firmly in the main event conversation.

stories.title: Grayson Waller Return to NXT Drama
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller returned to NXT on July 28 and delivered a scathing promo attacking the men's division for being soft and lazy, claiming only 10 percent of the roster was main roster ready. NXT star Saquon Shugars fired back on social media, accusing Waller of only training when women are around and saying he couldn't lace Duke Hudson's boots.

stories.title: WWE NXT Google Search Interest Analysis
stories.tldr: WWE NXT is experiencing a significant decline in Google search interest, dropping 20% over the last 90 days compared to the previous quarter, with year-over-year comparisons also showing a 7% decline. While the brand does experience weekly fluctuations, the absence of an announced Premium Live Event to build momentum has contributed to the overall downward trend, though recent episodes appear to be stabilizing at a baseline level heading into summer.

stories.title: WWE Radio Launch
stories.tldr: WWE has launched WWE Radio, a 24/7 audio channel on SiriusXM channel 156, continuing the company's strategy of maximizing revenue streams and market share. The move capitalizes on the proven profitability of wrestling podcasts from personalities like Jim Cornette and Eric Bischoff, with WWE positioning itself to capture that lucrative market segment that had previously existed outside the company's direct control.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton WWE Career
stories.tldr: Tiffany Stratton has revealed that her friendship with Chelsea Green has grown significantly over time, despite initial hesitation from Stratton who felt Green had kicked her when she was down. The two have formed a tag team and shared comedic segments on WWE SmackDown, with Green recently helping Stratton retain her Women's United States Championship at Night of Champions. However, their friendship will be tested at SummerSlam where they will compete against each other for the vacant WWE Women's Championship.

stories.title: WWE and Entertainment Collaborations
stories.tldr: Rapper Ken Carson is launching a WWE-inspired clothing collection on July 31 through Complex, continuing WWE's recent trend of high-profile collaborations with musicians. The partnership follows similar ventures with Travis Scott and Lil Yachty, showcasing the sports entertainment company's expanding presence in hip-hop and popular culture.

stories.title: CM Punk Cody Rhodes WWE Championship
stories.tldr: CM Punk acknowledged that Cody Rhodes has surpassed his own WWE achievements during an interview on WWE Radio ahead of their SummerSlam 2026 match. Punk praised Rhodes' career trajectory, noting that while they followed similar paths of leaving and returning to WWE, Rhodes accomplished things Punk never did. Despite the mutual respect, Punk said they will settle who is the better man in the ring at SummerSlam.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Wrestling Gear Explanation
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio explained on a recent podcast that he wears a protective vest during WWE matches not purely for character purposes, but for practical protection. Since he's taller but not as muscular as many of his opponents, the vest with built-in padding helps shield him from their strikes. He even revealed that opponents like Gunther have deliberately removed the padding to target his bare chest, though he remains open to wrestling shirtless in the future.

stories.title: Mr. SummerSlam Countdown Edge
stories.tldr: Edge ranks fourth in a countdown of wrestlers with the most Match of the Year performances at WWE's SummerSlam, having competed in 11 matches at the event since 1998. The article highlights his five best matches, beginning with the groundbreaking 2000 Tables, Ladders, and Chairs match against the Dudley Boyz and Hardy Boyz, which Dave Meltzer rated ****1/2 and 77% of readers voted as that night's best match.

stories.title: Matt Cardona WWE Return Discussion
stories.tldr: Cardona explained the chaotic path to his January 2026 return, including surprise last-minute gear changes and a disappointing initial Triple H call that seemed to lead nowhere. He expressed frustration over being misrepresented by Cody Rhodes and Kevin Owens during indie discussions, though he's now moved past it. Going forward, Cardona aims to become WWE Champion and is prepared for a heel turn when the timing is right.

stories.title: Mike Santana/Cruz Montana WWE NXT Debut
stories.tldr: Cruz Montana (formerly Mike Santana) is now one week into his WWE NXT run and has revealed deeper personal meaning behind his new ring name, which honors his late father who passed away six years ago. The former two-time TNA World Champion is already targeting NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo and has stated he won't put a timetable on his NXT tenure, wanting to learn as much as possible under Shawn Michaels' leadership.

stories.title: CM Punk Responds To Grayson Waller WWE NXT Promo
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller returned to NXT with a fiery shoot promo criticizing Austin Theory, the NXT men's roster, and new arrival Cruz Montana. CM Punk publicly praised the promo on social media, comparing Waller's anger to a focused attack on the competition. The segment ended with WWE production cutting Waller's microphone before a three-way brawl broke out involving D'Angelo and Montana.

stories.title: WWE Raw and SmackDown Updates
stories.tldr: Triple H was heavily involved behind the scenes during the Brock Lesnar-Oba Femi weigh-in segment that opened Raw's SummerSlam go-home show, calling audibles for Femi's physical spots and coordinating the segment's timing. The weigh-in saw Lesnar lock security inside the Hell in a Cell before positioning himself outside, setting up Saturday's match with an interesting visual dynamic.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Viewership Updates
stories.tldr: The July 24 SmackDown episode drew 1.253 million viewers and a 0.23 demo rating, marking the show's largest audience since May 22. While up week-to-week, the numbers show significant year-over-year decline compared to July 2025, when the show drew 1.707 million viewers with a 0.48 demo rating.

stories.title: Jade Cargill WWE SummerSlam
stories.tldr: At Fanatics Fest, Jade Cargill opened up about a wig mishap during her June 12 SmackDown Queen of the Ring match against Charlotte Flair, Sol Ruca, and Lyra Valkyria. She discussed how she initially panicked but persevered to finish the match with one hand, and revealed her frustration with the SummerSlam format change from a singles bout with Flair to a multi-woman ladder match for the Interim WWE Women's Championship.

stories.title: Liv Morgan WWE Women's World Champion
stories.tldr: Liv Morgan has pushed back against criticism of her 100-day title reign without a defense, declaring on social media that her star power speaks for itself. The champion confidently stated "I'm that iconic, you don't need to defend sh*t," dismissing the lack of title matches as a testament to her drawing power rather than a weakness.

stories.title: Royce Keys Free Agency from AEW to WWE
stories.tldr: Keys has now been in WWE for seven months since his Royal Rumble debut and will compete in his first SummerSlam match this weekend. He compared his free agency decision to LeBron James' move and emphasized there were no second thoughts about signing with WWE, describing his transition as "all love" from day one.

stories.title: Michael Cole WWE Commentary
stories.tldr: Michael Cole has reflected on what distinguished Jim Ross from other commentators, revealing that JR's emotional connection to his calls made him legendary. Cole explained how he spent a decade discovering his own voice while being weighed down by the "replacement" label, ultimately finding confidence when he realized he belonged in the role.

stories.title: Otis WWE RAW Injury
stories.tldr: Following the chair attack that sidelined Otis, new details have emerged about the aftermath. Maxxine Dupri taunted the injured Alpha Academy member, declaring he'll never find a woman like her, while The Vision celebrated the brutal assault that left Otis written off indefinitely.

stories.title: Becky Lynch WWE Absence
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch doubled down on her absence strategy in a new SiriusXM interview, insisting WWE needs her support more than ever and comparing her role to being a "lighthouse" that shows the company what it's missing. She's confident that upon her return, fans will realize she was essential all along.

stories.title: Nikki Bella Retirement Plans
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella has clarified her creative ambitions for her final year-and-a-half in WWE, emphasizing she wants to finish on her own terms without regrets. She's committed to pushing boundaries creatively, challenging herself in the ring, and continuing to elevate other women in the division. She's currently recovering from an ankle injury that sidelined her from WrestleMania 42 and is set to team with Brie Bella and Paige against Fatal Influence at SummerSlam Night 1.

stories.title: Ryan Garcia WWE RAW Segment
stories.tldr: The Ryan Garcia segment on RAW drew significant fan backlash on social media and YouTube, with the video receiving far more dislikes than likes. Fans criticized the segment as cringe-worthy and out of place, with the dead crowd reaction amplifying the negative reception. Multiple comments compared it to a moment that would embarrass wrestling fans in front of non-wrestling viewers.

stories.title: AJ Styles WWE Recommendations and Commentary
stories.tldr: AJ Styles elaborated on his World Heavyweight Championship stance during his podcast, revealing that Bron Breakker recently recovered from hernia surgery and is now "even scarier than before." Styles emphasized the importance of the babyface-versus-heel dynamic and suggested The Judgment Day's healing could set up compelling storylines going forward, though he stopped short of calling for the group's breakup.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez WWE Women's Intercontinental Champion
stories.tldr: Now that Raquel Rodriguez holds the WWE Women's Intercontinental Championship, multiple wrestlers are positioning themselves as potential challengers. Among the top contenders are Lyra Valkyria, who recently turned on Bayley and has already called out the title; Becky Lynch, who claims she made the championship and has been absent; and Maxxine Dupri, who won the title in 2025 and now has The Vision backing her. Sol Ruca, the former champion seeking redemption, along with NXT's Lola Vice and a potentially returning Bayley, also loom as future challengers.

stories.title: Dutch Mantell Commentary
stories.tldr: Dutch Mantell has made several commentary statements including criticism of Keith Lee's lack of personality and drawing power, defense of WWE's $99 Club WWE membership program as a voluntary revenue stream, and skepticism that Ludwig Kaiser's battery case will result in serious consequences given the lack of reported injuries.

stories.title: TKO CEO Ari Emanuel Corporate News
stories.tldr: TKO CEO Ari Emanuel has published an op-ed in The Wall Street Journal defending the proposed $110.9 billion Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger, arguing that the antitrust lawsuit filed by California and 11 other state attorneys general threatens competition rather than protecting it. Emanuel contends the lawsuit ignores major competitors like Amazon MGM, Netflix, A24, and Lionsgate, and warns that blocking the deal could leave WBD financially unable to invest in content while allowing newer rivals to dominate. The merger outcome could significantly impact professional wrestling and combat sports, as it would potentially connect UFC and Zuffa Boxing on Paramount+ with AEW under the same corporate structure.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio AAA Mega Title Match
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio was hit in the head with a peso coin thrown by a fan during his AAA Mega Championship defense against Dragon Lee at Heroes Inmortales in October 2025. While throwing money in the ring is a traditional Mexican wrestling fan gesture meant to show appreciation for an excellent match, Mysterio noted that some fans throw coins with malicious intent rather than kindness.

stories.title: Sareee & Takumi Iroha vs. Natsupoi & Saori Anou To Headline Sareee-ISM Chapter XI
stories.tldr: Sareee will team with Takumi Iroha to face STARDOM's Natsupoi and Saori Anou in the main event of Sareee-ISM Chapter XI on August 24th at Shinjuku FACE venue. The event will take place before the venue closes at the end of September 2026, with multiple promotions scheduled to run shows there during that period. Natsupoi will retire from in-ring competition in January 2027.

stories.title: NWA Carson Drake EMERGE Title Challenge
stories.tldr: NWA star Carson Drake will make his EMERGE Wrestling debut on August 1, 2026, at EMERGE 98: Back In The Saddle in Columbus, Indiana, with an immediate title opportunity against Outbreak Champion Tre LaMar. Drake enters the match as a former NWA World Television Champion and current NWA-JCP Southeastern Champion on an active singles winning streak. LaMar has successfully defended the Outbreak Championship against competitors from nationally recognized promotions and has developed strong fan connections within EMERGE.

stories.title: Paul Atlas WCW Story
stories.tldr: Paul Atlas is a Pittsburgh wrestling veteran who broke into the business in 1990 during the territorial system's decline and built a respected career through independent promotions like Pro Wrestling Express during the late-90s wrestling boom. Despite suffering cumulative injuries from his demanding schedule, Atlas established himself as a solid performer and trainer in the Pittsburgh area, eventually reforming The Wrong Crowd tag team with Brian Anthony to return to the national spotlight.

stories.title: Dave Bautista WCW Tryout
stories.tldr: Dave Bautista was rejected during a WCW tryout early in his wrestling career, with officials telling him he didn't have what it took to be a professional wrestler. After borrowing money from friends, he trained at Wild Small Wrestling Camp in Pennsylvania and eventually signed with WWE, debuting on television in 2002 and becoming one of the biggest stars of that era.

stories.title: Title Changes on July 28
stories.tldr: July 28th has been a historically significant date for professional wrestling title changes, with approximately 251 major title changes occurring on this date throughout wrestling history. Notable champions crowned on July 28th include Silver King winning the CMLL World Heavyweight Title in 1994, Eddie Guerrero capturing the ECW World Television Title in 1995, and Dolph Ziggler winning the WWE Intercontinental Championship in 2010. The date has seen title changes across multiple wrestling promotions spanning from 1977 through 2018, with particularly high activity in 2002 when six championships changed hands in a single day.

stories.title: Wren Sinclair Defending WWE Women's Speed Title, In Hopes Of NA Title Shot
stories.tldr: Wren Sinclair will defend her WWE Women's Speed Championship against NXT Women's North American Champion Zaria next week. If Sinclair retains her title, she will earn a future shot at Zaria's North American Championship. The match came about after both champions approached GM Robert Stone seeking new challengers, with Sinclair suggesting that Zaria could enter a tournament while holding the more prestigious title, similar to how Sol Ruca previously held both titles.

stories.title: Daily Update: Charlotte Flair vs. Alexa Bliss on Hot Ones, Braun Strowman, Main Event Mafia reunion
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss appeared together on Hot Ones Versus, while the Main Event Mafia reunion was highlighted at WrestleCon. The week featured various WWE talent on different media appearances including R-Truth on Snack Wars, the Bella Twins on Variety, and upcoming collaborations with Ken Carson and Trish Stratus events. Additionally, WWE released a Director's Cut of the Cody Rhodes vs. John Cena SummerSlam match and added classic content to their vault.

stories.title: WOL: ESPN and WWE, how fans discover wrestling, RAW, name changes
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Live discussed how ESPN's involvement has not meaningfully boosted WWE viewership, while Impact Wrestling has seen ratings improvements. The show also covered how fans discover wrestling in 2026, Mike Santana's name change in TNA, and provided a RAW report with commentary on the importance of not dismissing wrestler names too quickly.

stories.title: 8 WWE Stars To Become NXT Coaches
stories.tldr: WWE has established a natural career path for aging wrestlers through the Performance Center and NXT coaching positions. The article identifies eight current WWE stars who could potentially transition into NXT coaching roles based on their experience training talent, with examples including Nattie, Pete Dunne, Kevin Owens, Bayley, Finn Balor, and Seth Rollins, each bringing unique perspectives and training backgrounds from their careers.

stories.title: WWE HOFer JBL Muses On Vince McMahon's Place In WWE/TKO Post-Lawsuit
stories.tldr: With the Janel Grant lawsuit heading to arbitration, Vince McMahon may be positioned to return to WWE/TKO after resolving most of his legal troubles, though the accusations remain. WWE Hall of Famer JBL expressed optimism about McMahon's potential comeback while acknowledging uncertainty about whether TKO leadership would allow it, citing both their sensitivity to controversy and their personal ties to McMahon.

stories.title: Summer Rae Says She Misses WWE Every Day, Reveals Texts She Sent To Cathy Kelley & Renee Paquette
stories.tldr: Summer Rae (Danielle Moinet) has revealed that she misses WWE every day but appreciates being off the road and enjoying a social life. The former WWE Superstar has transitioned to Bare Knuckle Boxing broadcasting and has messaged Cathy Kelley and Renee Paquette, telling them they had the right idea by working as interviewers rather than in-ring competitors to preserve their bodies.

stories.title: TNA Impact Righteous Deletion Episode
stories.tldr: The Righteous Deletion episode's success was driven by its main event featuring TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth versus KC Navarro, which exceeded recent pay-per-view quality. The show also featured Moose & Elijah taking on AJ Francis & Kazarian, continued the Knockouts TV Title tournament, and revealed Mustafa Ali's next International Championship challenger.

stories.title: AAA Growth and Rey Mysterio
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio reflected on AAA's accelerated global expansion under WWE, drawing parallels to lucha libre's earlier breakthrough in WCW during the 1990s. He emphasized that the current partnership fulfills a long-standing vision from wrestling pioneers like Konnan to showcase Mexican wrestling worldwide. Mysterio expressed enthusiasm about witnessing the promotion's rapid evolution while serving in an on-screen authority role alongside his son Dominik, who currently holds the AAA Mega Championship.

stories.title: Kairi Sane Free Agency Update
stories.tldr: Kairi Sane is actively evaluating her options as a free agent following her WWE non-compete expiration. She has not committed to any organization and is receiving offers for both contracted deals and non-contracted appearances from multiple companies.

stories.title: Ryback Defends WWE Veteran From Mockery After In-Ring Return
stories.tldr: Following online mockery of Val Venis's return match, Ryback defended the WWE veteran by highlighting the positive in-arena crowd reaction. Ryback used the moment to critique how social media amplifies negativity compared to real-world human behavior, urging fans to protect their energy and focus on positivity rather than tearing others down.

stories.title: Triple H Made Changes To Brock Lesnar & Oba Femi WWE Raw Segment Ahead Of Hell In A Cell Match At SummerSlam 2026
stories.tldr: Triple H made last-minute adjustments to the Lesnar vs. Femi segment on Raw, including calling live audibles during Femi's security attack and moving the segment from later in the show to the opening. WWE has also confirmed their Hell in a Cell match will take place on night one of SummerSlam, raising questions about Femi's trajectory if he wins.

stories.title: AEW Redemption and Road to All In London
